text:
devrel-rae: Ping — released Community Glossary & Style Starter v1.0.0 :tada: Helps external contributors align copy, terminology, and accessibility notes across repos. Repo + release: https://github.com/redwood/comm-glossary/releases/tag/v1.0.0
devrel-rae: What's included: shared term definitions, contributor-friendly style rules, a tiny l10n template, and a script to validate term usage across markdown/docs. Aim is to reduce reviewer churn on wording/brand questions.
ci-bot: CI: tag `v1.0.0` created and release artifacts published for redwood/comm-glossary 44d All checks passed
localization-ivan: Nice! added a basic PO file example and a short note on pseudo-localization in docs/i18n.md. will follow up with a localization checklist PR.
docs-zoe: Suggest adding a short section for accessibility phrasing (e.g., how to describe visuals, alt text tone). I'll draft two example lines.
oliver: Could we add a lint step to catch disallowed brand terms? that would be great to enforce automatically in CI for docs PRs.
devrel-rae: @oliver good call. there's an example GH action under .github/workflows/term-lint.yaml that uses the term-list.json — opt-in per repo. will link in the README.
ci-bot: Release notes snippet added:
```
# quick start
git clone https://github.com/redwood/comm-glossary.git
cd comm-glossary
pnpm install
pnpm run validate-docs -- repo=../your-repo
```
devrel-rae: We'll host a short demo + Q&A tomorrow 3pm PT in #eng-docs. If maintainers want the term-lint enabled org-wide, please add a 👍 reaction to the release thread in the repo.
localization-ivan: I'll be at the demo and can show how to adapt the PO templates for different languages.
docs-zoe: I'll include a blurb in next week's community newsletter. small ask: can we include a changelog entry for the term updates?
devrel-rae: Yes — changelog is automated from PR labels; i'll make sure maintainers know to tag `chore/docs` when updating terms. thanks everyone!
